plotEn:
Kim Ki-ho, a widower adjusting to retirement, finds himself increasingly unfulfilled by his otherwise comfortable routine. Living alone, he maintains the habit of placing flowers before his late wife's photograph each morning. When he comes across an advertisement seeking a senior intern, he applies for a position at Woo22, a rapidly growing fashion company founded by Lee Sun-woo three years earlier. Woo22 hires Ki-ho alongside several younger interns, including Park Ju-seong and Oh Yun-hee, on three-month contracts.
Unfamiliar with the workplace culture of younger employees, Ki-ho attempts to prepare for his new position by researching how to communicate with the younger generation. However, he discovers that the company has little intention of assigning him meaningful responsibilities, having hired him primarily to obtain tax incentives. His supervisor, team leader Choi Min-a, and Sun-woo rarely give him assignments, leaving him with little to do. Rather than simply waiting for his contract to expire, Ki-ho begins looking for ways to contribute. Although some of his initial efforts lead to complications, he gradually finds ways to make himself useful and develops relationships with the younger interns and other employees.
